name: Marketing to Sign-up
primary_user_goal: Learn about Slack and decide to create an account
business_goal: Convert website visitors to registered users

name: Workspace Onboarding
primary_user_goal: Create a workspace and invite team members
business_goal: Activate new workspaces with multiple users for network effects
exit_point: User reaches workspace with initial setup complete

name: Daily Usage
primary_user_goal: Navigate, read, and participate in team conversations
business_goal: Drive daily engagement and message volume
exit_point: User closes app or switches workspace

name: Thread Interaction
primary_user_goal: Follow and participate in focused threaded discussions
business_goal: Enable deeper conversations without disrupting channel flow
entry_point: Click on thread indicator or 'Reply in thread' action
exit_point: Thread panel closed or navigation away

name: Search
primary_user_goal: Find specific messages, files, channels, or people
business_goal: Enable information retrieval and increase platform value
entry_point: Cmd+K shortcut or search bar click
exit_point: User navigates to search result or cancels search

name: Notification Settings
primary_user_goal: Customize notification preferences to reduce noise
business_goal: Prevent notification fatigue and churn while maintaining engagement

name: App Integrations
primary_user_goal: Extend Slack with third-party apps and automations
business_goal: Increase platform stickiness and ecosystem value
entry_point: Apps button in sidebar or 'Add apps' action
exit_point: App installed and configured in workspace

name: Huddle
primary_user_goal: Have a quick audio/video conversation with teammates
business_goal: Increase real-time engagement and reduce reliance on external meeting tools
entry_point: Huddle button in channel or DM header
